# 📦 Server Storage Item Frame  
### 100% Server-Side • No Client Required

---

![Storage Hub and Storage Item Frame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/QRB0qGCX/images/5ebdb571db9e8a2cbb991f9c0bbce2e17288a26c.png)

![Chest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/432684ec840efd8beafb2cbedfef88c3f7381fac.png)

---

## ✨ Overview
**Server Storage Item Frame** enhances storage management without requiring any client-side installation.

Turn your storage system into a **clean, visual, and interactive network** using invisible item frames and a centralized deposit hub—perfect for multiplayer servers that want functionality without forcing mods on players.

---

## 🛠 Features

### 🖼 Storage Item Frames
Transform any container into a **smart visual storage slot**.

- **Invisible Frames**  
  Only the item and its quantity are visible for a clean look.

- **Live Item Count**  
  Automatically displays the total amount across all connected containers.

- **Smart Chain Detection**  
  Scans up to **5 blocks deep** behind the frame  
  ✔ Supports double chests  
  ✔ Works with complex storage walls

- **Quick Interactions**
  - **Right-Click:** Withdraw 1 item  
  - **Sneak + Right-Click:** Withdraw a full stack  
  - **Left-Click:** Deposit held item  
  - **Sneak + Left-Click:** Deposit full stack  

---

### 🧭 Storage Hub
A **centralized deposit block** (based on the Lodestone).

- **Instant Sorting**  
  Punch the hub with an item to automatically send it to the correct storage.

- **Smart Matching**  
  Finds the appropriate Storage Item Frame and container chain.

- **Visual Feedback**  
  Item transfer is shown with **particle trails** from the hub to the destination.

## ❓ FAQ

### Why Server-Side Only?
Most storage mods require both client and server installation.  
This mod is designed to work **entirely on the server**, so players can join without installing anything.

---

### Why No Custom Textures?
To stay fully server-side, the mod reuses **vanilla Minecraft assets**—no resource packs needed.

---

### Will There Be Updates?
Possibly! This is currently a side project, but improvements and new features may come over time.

---

## 💡 Why Use This Mod?

- ✔ No client installation required  
- ✔ Clean and minimal visual storage system  
- ✔ Perfect for SMP and public servers  
- ✔ Vanilla-friendly design  
- ✔ Fast and intuitive item management
